summary: The failing run_reviewer/run_coder/run_manager boundary for this session is not the diedrico runtime on port 8081. It is the Manager/control-plane service saivage.service, PID 7105, running /usr/bin/node dist/cli.js serve /work/saivage-v3 from WorkingDirectory=/opt/saivage. That deployed /opt/saivage tree is stale relative to /work/saivage-v3 commits 41d8810 and e65b81b: /opt/saivage lacks dist/src/schemas/worker-dispatch-envelope-normalizer.js and its schemas/index.js and manager-envelope-normalizer.js hashes differ from /work/saivage-v3/dist. Therefore the live session tools are validating/returning with stale compiled schema-boundary code even though /work/saivage-v3 builds successfully.

1_active_runtime_tool_boundary.answer: The active run_* worker-dispatch/control-plane boundary for this session is the systemd unit saivage.service, not saivage-v3.service. Non-secret process evidence shows PID 7105: /usr/bin/node dist/cli.js serve /work/saivage-v3, cwd /opt/saivage, cgroup /system.slice/saivage.service. The v3 product runtime is separate: PID 19733: /usr/bin/node /opt/saivage/bin/saivage.js start --create-runtime --port 8081 --host 0.0.0.0, cgroup /system.slice/saivage-v3.service, WorkingDirectory=/work/diedrico-lessons. Source files under /work/saivage-v3/src/schemas define the intended normalization, but the active control plane imports compiled code from /opt/saivage/dist, not directly from /work/saivage-v3/src.
evidence: systemctl show saivage.service: WorkingDirectory=/opt/saivage; ExecStart=/usr/bin/node dist/cli.js serve /work/saivage-v3; MainPID=7105; ActiveState=active.
ps probe: PID 7105 /usr/bin/node dist/cli.js serve /work/saivage-v3; PID 19733 /usr/bin/node /opt/saivage/bin/saivage.js start --create-runtime --port 8081 --host 0.0.0.0.
systemctl status showed saivage.service emitting current inspector agent activity, confirming it is the live control-plane service for this session.

2_stale_or_different_code.answer: Yes. The live boundary is using stale deployed compiled code under /opt/saivage. It is a deployment copy, not the current /work/saivage-v3/dist output. /opt/saivage/dist/src/schemas/worker-dispatch-envelope-normalizer.js is missing, while /work/saivage-v3/dist/src/schemas/worker-dispatch-envelope-normalizer.js exists. /opt/saivage/dist/src/schemas/index.js does not export normalizeWorkerDispatchTaskReport, while /work/saivage-v3/dist/src/schemas/index.js does. /opt/saivage/dist/src/schemas/manager-envelope-normalizer.js still imports normalizeTaskReport directly; current /work/saivage-v3/dist imports normalizeWorkerDispatchTaskReport from ./worker-dispatch-envelope-normalizer.js.
evidence: Current /work/saivage-v3 HEAD is e65b81b468b5b3a84738d19392d6a620ac0edccb, with 41d8810 and e65b81b in recent git log.

Code comparison: /opt/saivage/dist/src/schemas/manager-envelope-normalizer.js imports normalizeTaskReport and calls normalizeTaskReport(rawReport); /work/saivage-v3/dist/src/schemas/manager-envelope-normalizer.js imports normalizeWorkerDispatchTaskReport and calls normalizeWorkerDispatchTaskReport(rawReport, { source: `reports/${reportFile}` }).

3_minimal_action_needed.answer: Deploy the current built /work/saivage-v3 output to the active control-plane tree /opt/saivage and restart saivage.service. The minimally targeted file set for the observed stale schema boundary is dist/src/schemas/worker-dispatch-envelope-normalizer.js, worker-dispatch-envelope-normalizer.d.ts, manager-envelope-normalizer.js, manager-envelope-normalizer.d.ts, index.js, and index.d.ts from /work/saivage-v3/dist/src/schemas to /opt/saivage/dist/src/schemas, followed by systemctl restart saivage.service. Safer release action: run npm run build in /work/saivage-v3, rsync the built project/deploy layout to /opt/saivage, then restart saivage.service. Restarting only saivage-v3.service on port 8081 will not update the session run_* tools because they are served by saivage.service PID 7105.
3_minimal_action_needed.rationale: The source/build already contains normalizeWorkerDispatchTaskReport and exports it. The live failure persists because the serving /opt/saivage control-plane process has not loaded those built files. Node will not pick up replaced ESM modules until the process restarts.

4_ownership.answer: The source fix is within /work/saivage-v3 ownership and already appears present in commits 41d8810 and e65b81b. Applying it to the active run_* boundary requires deployment/restart of /opt/saivage and saivage.service, which is outside the source tree but within the stated supervisor/operator deployment privileges. It does not require changes to /work/diedrico-lessons/diedrico or secret-bearing files. If policy treats the current session's saivage.service as operator-owned control-plane infrastructure rather than v3 deploy surface, then an operator/runtime restart is required; technically, the required change is a stale deploy/restart, not new application code.

findings.title: Active run_* session tools are served by stale /opt/saivage control-plane deployment
findings.details: The current inspector session is executing inside saivage.service from /opt/saivage. That tree lacks the newly built worker-dispatch normalizer file and has stale schema index/manager normalizer compiled outputs. Successful source build in /work/saivage-v3 is therefore insufficient for live run_reviewer/run_coder/run_manager behavior until /opt/saivage is redeployed and saivage.service restarted.

findings.title: The diedrico v3 runtime service is not the failing control-plane boundary
findings.details: saivage-v3.service is active on port 8081 from /opt/saivage/bin/saivage.js with WorkingDirectory=/work/diedrico-lessons, but the run_* tools used by this planning/worker session are associated with saivage.service, whose ExecStart is dist/cli.js serve /work/saivage-v3. Fix validation for this session by updating/restarting saivage.service, not only the diedrico runtime.
